basics.name: Kyle M. Anderson
basics.summary: Technical professional with software development, systems integration, project management, and client-support experience, including migration of production workloads from DigitalOcean to AWS. Builds and supports software platforms, improves application performance, and coordinates implementation work from requirements gathering through go-live support. Earlier experience includes platform implementation, web automation, SharePoint administration, and operational data analysis.

work.name: DSTax Technologies
work.summary: Manager serving as a technical lead and lead developer for a tax-integration platform, with responsibilities spanning integration development, project coordination, client support, troubleshooting, implementation assistance, and documentation.
highlights: Migrated production workloads from DigitalOcean to AWS.
Served as Lead Developer and Project Manager.
Led the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 of the tax-integration platform.
Optimized asynchronous operations to improve performance and throughput.
Managed internal development projects and client-coordinated work, sharing integration updates, reporting status, and responding to questions and requests.
Supported end-to-end integration implementations, including requirements gathering, setup, troubleshooting, and go-live support.
Develop integrations between financial platforms and tax providers.
Supported integrations with Acumatica, Chargebee, Sage Intacct, WooCommerce, Magento/Adobe Commerce, Thomson Reuters, Vertex, Sovos, and SureTax.
Created and maintained client integration guides and knowledge-base articles.

work.name: Colectivo Coffee Roasters
highlights: Partnered with the IT department to install and troubleshoot new point-of-sale nodes.
Fulfilled orders for more than 1000 restaurant and store clients.
Updated invoices for inventory changes to help maintain accurate records.

work.name: Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global)
highlights: Evaluated, selected, and implemented a global mapping platform that provided facility information to employees and customers.
Initiated web automations that reduced manual database-maintenance work.
Managed SharePoint sites and data and designed data-input forms to improve accessibility, reduce errors, and promote cross-department information sharing.
Analyzed asset and facilities databases, identifying more than $10 million in previously unidentified asset value that informed the sale of unused assets before Komatsu's acquisition of Joy Global.
